intro.title: Indonesian Hospitality, Brought to the Silk Road
intro.body1: EBI Resources is a holding company that unites a portfolio of hospitality and lifestyle destinations under one corporate identity — where the warmth of Indonesian hospitality meets the Silk Road heritage of Uzbekistan.
intro.body2: Our businesses span hotels, restaurants, and a specialty café, complemented by a growing technology practice and a travel line in development.
